narr: Thunderstorms produced torrential rainfall that led to flash flooding from the evening of July 6 into the morning of July 7 in parts of the panhandle as well as central Nebraska.
ev: One to two feet of water was reported on Highway 20 near Clinton.
Emergency management reported a washout near the intersection of roads 189 and 82 due to flooding.
Emergency management reported six inches of water over Highway 183 at Sargent due to heavy rain.
